notes:
- Real upper floors: some rooms now have a whole second storey over the room, with a stairwell,
  railings, its own lights and furniture (shelves, lockers, beds, benches, crates). Mess Hall, Infirmary
  and Guard Office in the Prison; Corner Store and Pharmacy in the Outskirts; Bio Lab, Cryo Storage and
  Security Station in the Lab. The Mess Hall and Bio Lab are always there, so every map has one.
- Courtyards: the Prison has a Courtyard next to Intake (grass, a fountain, trees in planters,
  benches and lamp posts). The Outskirts can have a Town Square, and the Lab has a Hydroponics Atrium
  next to Decontamination (an underground garden under grow lights).
- Releases: only the newest 3 versions stay in the downloads repo.
